about: The FX Filter of the effect rack of the Audio Unit (FXFilter, an item of type 8, alone in the rack; osc A off, the noise oscillator plays samples of ours one-shot at 44.1 kHz, rendered at 48 kHz unless said). Its plain params: kParamType (codes: `codes`), kParamFreq (a knob: written as the note 136.8 v of the voice filter, `cut` in Hz), kParamReso, kParamDrive, kParamVar (%), kParamStereo (Pan, %), kParamWet (%), kParamLevelOut (a knob); Wet 100 unless said. input: the dry level of a harmonic of the multisine against the sample (dB). Gains: dB against the empty rack (-120 at least) at harmonics of 32.703 Hz: a multisine on C1 (harmonics 1..`top` of one magnitude, Schroeder phases, the amplitude 0.09 in the sample), read over 1 s from 0.5 s. fresh: [left, right] of a fresh filter at `freshHarmonics`. untyped: [cut, res, gains] without kParamType. responses: [type, cut, res, gains] at `harmonics[cut]` (those of filter-types.json up to `top`), Drive and Var 0. rates: the same at 44.1 kHz. pan: [cut, pan, left, right] Low 12 at Res 0.75 at `panHarmonics[cut]`. mix: rows [wet, a, b, rest] a render at Wet as a·(Wet 0) + b·(Wet 100) (least squares over 1 s of the left channel; rest dB under it), Low 12 at 1 kHz Res 0.5; dry [a, 0, rest] Wet 0 as a·(the empty rack). level: [knob, dB] Low 12 open at harmonic 3. Sines (ours, 44.1 kHz): [gain of the fundamental (dB), harmonics 2..7 under it (dB)]. driveLaw: [drive, gain] a sine of 220 Hz at 0.001 before Low 12 open; driveCurves: [type, drive, amplitude, gain, harmonics] 220 Hz; fat: [type, res, var, amplitude, gain, harmonics] a sine at the cutoff (987.8 Hz). smoothing: Macro 1 routed to kParamFreq by 30 %, Low 12 Res 0 from the knob 0.5 (430 Hz) to 0.8 (7.2 kHz) as the macro steps 0 → 1 at 0.6 s and back at 1.0 s (set every sample): [ms after the step, dB] of a sine of 2 kHz at 0.3 through it (the peak of |y| over a period), by step. lfo: --only=fxfilter-lfo, LFO 1 (a triangle from 0 up, from the note) on kParamFreq by `amount` % from the knob 0.5, a sine of 2 kHz at 0.3 through Low 12 at the Res of each case; lfoRows: [case, the sample from the start of the sine, dB of the sine against 0.3 (the rms of a period, centred)] every 32 samples over a cycle from 1 s. ring: [type, dB every 50 ms] of the mean square after 50 ms of a noise at 0.1, Res 1 at 1 kHz. scripts/renders/run.mjs --only=fxfilter
